question: Can an improving system inherit only what receiver evidence shows it actually earned?

dependency.role: derive candidate, inherited, and questioned standing from signed receiver evidence

frozen_generator.provider: fake Hermes adapter through the real Nightshift path
frozen_generator.rule: the Hermes executable and harness fingerprint must not change during generation

sequence: Nightshift selects one independently measured ordinary-code winner and writes its signed generation receipt.
The selection process exits before receiver installation; memory must remain candidate and the installation ref must remain at base.
A new process reconstructs standing only from disk, installs the exact selected commit, observes the receiver ref, and signs an exact promotion-execution receipt; memory must become inherited.
A controlled support witness is removed and a later receiver-signed REOPEN is issued; memory must become questioned for the next generation while installed code remains unchanged.
pass_conditions: selection alone derives candidate with survived=0
no promotion receipt exists across the interruption boundary
restart reconstructs candidate from persisted evidence
a validly signed promotion for the wrong commit is rejected
exact observed installation derives inherited with survived=1
inherited appears in the established next-generation set
signed REOPEN after controlled support loss derives questioned
questioned is absent from the established next-generation set
REOPEN leaves the installed ref unchanged
generator executable hash and Nightshift harness remain frozen
falsifiers: restart needs volatile state from the selection process
REOPEN fails to remove memory from the next-generation established set
Hermes generator or harness changes during the generation
claim_boundary: No paid live-Hermes claim; the provider is a deterministic fake executable exercised through Nightshift.
No production deployment claim; receiver installation is an isolated synthetic Git ref.
No general evidence-loss detector claim; support loss is a controlled missing-witness falsifier.
No Generator Gate claim; generator self-modification is RSI-002.
